description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Fecundity.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Chamber Sentry from your library.
Repeat.
